Show every crocheted product as high-end photorealistic editorial product photography, never illustration: visible yarn fibres, authentic crochet loops, stitch definition, handmade depth and slight natural irregularity. Use softly styled linen or a neutral interior surface, gentle natural light, soft dimensional shadows, airy premium composition and romantic handmade mood. Watercolour and drawn ornamentation belong to the branding layer only.
